exercises.question: Identify the sentence that follows the correct underlying grammatical verb pattern.
options: My project manager wants that I finish this data report by tonight.
I am really looking forward to visit the new office next month.
He decided to stop smoking because of his changing health priorities.
She thoroughly enjoys to read historical novels in her spare time.
exercises.feedbackCorrect: Perfect choice. The verb decide is systematically followed by an infinitive construction (to stop).
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: Look closely at the verb demands. The verb want follows the pattern want + someone + to do something (not "wants that I finish"). The phrase look forward to contains a preposition, meaning it must take a gerund (looking forward to visiting). The verb enjoy must be followed by a gerund (enjoys reading).

exercises.question: The coach encouraged the players ________ confident.
exercises.explanation: The pattern is 'encourage + object + to infinitive'.
